content: Consistency of non-volatile stored pre-stored data If the Dem is restoring pre-stored data according to [SWS_Dem_01322], the Dem shall only re- store this data if it is consistent to the current configuration. If after reprogramming or calibration, the data layout has changed, the Dem shall skip the pre-stored data.
